notes.title: Playtest update - April 3rd, 2025
notes.notes:
[h3]A Merry Cherry Blossom Spooky Spring! 🌸[/h3]

We've got another BIG update ready for y'all, packed with gameplay tweaks, visual upgrades, new effects, and quality-of-life improvements!
[list]
[*] Big UI overhaul with new animations, icons, states, etc
[*] New visual effects and improved animations for various spells, status effects, and enemy deaths
[*] Improved Spell Book visuals, removed unused textures, and added a new cursed page effect
[*] Enemies are now smarter around traps, actively avoiding them
[*] New quest lines being finalized for Brewmaster and Widow
[*] Brewing system implemented and will be available soon
[*] Ring system updated
[*] New spell added: Venom!
[*] New cave pool hazards introduced in Cave levels
[*] Enemy knockback and pain animations tweaked for improved combat feel
[*] Fast spell switching enabled to improve spell handling and make combat smoother
[*] Merchant tutorial text clarified, and merchant interactions improved
[*] The Caves biome is almost ready
[*] Improved procedural generation in Cave and Crypt levels for more interesting exploration
[*] Adjusted spawn logic so merchant chests reliably appear
[*] Various bug fixes, including save file issues, crosshair settings, and enemy collisions
[*] Numerous optimizations and visual upgrades to models, animations, and particle effects
[/list]
As always, thank you for your feedback! Let us know what you think of these updates.

For the best experience please delete any old save files you have.
Save files are located here:
[code]Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Spooky Dungeon\saves\
macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Spooky Dungeon/saves
[/code]
Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Playtest update - February 22nd, 2025
notes.notes:
Spookruary continues! We are following up on the recent major update by adding new mechanics, quality of life improvements, better controller support and overall polish to the player experience.

[h3]Death Mechanic[/h3]
[list]
[*] When you die you will lose some of your stuff and put up a cross
[*] Picking up a cross will recover some of the stuff you lost
[*] Loss of Orb Shells is more clearly visualized after you die
[/list]
[h3]Overhauled HUD[/h3]
[list]
[*] New HUD icons, animations and improved layout
[*] Losing or gaining orbs is better visualized in the game
[*] Added red color tints for health and mana when they're low
[/list]
[h3]Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] NPC services and quests now show up on the map
[*] Merchant will now show up on the map
[*] Crosses show up on the map
[/list]
[h3]Misc Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Projectiles now consider all attacks as impacts
[*] More consistent damage and status effects
[*] Enemies will now respawn with at least half health
[*] New caster hand animations and visuals
[*] Adjusted sound levels on sounds in town
[*] Added new Gravedigger animations
[*] Updated the barn, tavern, church, and town gate models, textures and collisions
[*] Updated visuals of various props in town
[*] Added option to disable the "Press Any Key" pause on the loading screen
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller button events are properly saved to settings
[*] Fixed crash related to controller support
[*] Fixed audio levels on various dialogs
[*] Fixed attenuation on fireballs and explosions sounds
[*] Fixed issues where the game could become corrupted if the player quit while dead
[*] Fixed issues with saving certain objects (picked up items/crosses, dead enemies)
[*] Fixed issues with the main menu flow
[*] Fixed shadow artifacts caused by moon light in town
[*] Fixed issues with rings not having any effect
[/list]
As always, we're grateful to you for your continued support, and hope you like these new updates!

For the best experience please delete any old save files you have.

[code]Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Spooky Dungeon\saves\

[/code]
Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Exciting playtest update - February 17th, 2025
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy Spookruary everyone![/h2]
We've been cooking through the cold, dark winter months and, boy, do we have something special for you! This huge update comes chock-full with lots of changes, tweaks, improvements, and content. Here’s a more in-depth look at what’s changed:

[h3]Combat & Spells[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now have a Mana Shield spell that can absorb incoming damage while active
[*] Countless balancing tweaks to spells and attacks
[*] Freeze spell can freeze up to 3 targets
[*] Balanced Fireball damage and knockback
[*] Enemies push each other in combat and can be pushed by the player, making close-quarters fights more dynamic
[/list]
[h3]Quests & Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Say hello to the Widow and the Merchant!
[*] New quest: Help the Priest find his Lost Heirloom!
[*] Added more NPC dialog during some quests
[/list]
[h3]Enemies & Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new boss: The Rotten Lich with some dangerous unique attacks
[*] Overhauled damage and health for all enemies
[*] Tweaked Skelly load out
[*] Updated path finding, movement and behaviors for all enemies
[/list]
[h3]Levels & Environment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added many more types of decorations (chains, archways, pillars, cages), giving each biome a distinct aesthetic
[*] New decorative props (banners, shelves, skeleton heads, etc) appear throughout the levels
[*] Made numerous improvements to the procedural level generation algorithms
[*] Some levels have custom spawn and exit rooms
[*] Levels can now have multiple sectors separated by locked doors
[*] Town environment updated (grass, leaves, lighting tweaks) for a spookier ambience
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Merchant now visits town, selling magical Rings and items in exchange for Spirit Oil
[*] Orb Shells and Spirit Oil form a new currency system - you can convert shells into oil using the Widow's cauldron
[*] Guiding spirits will help you find the exit portal in the dungeon
[*] Doors can be locked and require you to find a lever or a key
[*] Status effects are now clearly visualized
[*] The book UI has been overhauled
[*] Tweaked Spell Book model, plus new animations and improved audio sync for flipping pages
[*] HUD updates automatically on level load, ensuring correct health, mana, and stamina bars.
[*] Many behind-the-scenes improvements for stability and performance
[*] Too many other bug fixes and small improvements to count
[/list]
[h3]Technical Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more settings: max FPS, dialog volume, camera shake, etc
[*] Made numerous performance enhancements
[*] Better handling of multi-monitor setups
[/list]
As always, thank you for your continued support. We’re thrilled to see how you like the new characters, quests, items, and other changes!

For the best experience please delete any old save files you have.
Save files are located here:
[code]Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Spooky Dungeon\saves\
macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Spooky Dungeon/saves
[/code]
Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Big playtest update - October 24th
notes.notes:
Happy Spooktober everyone!

We've got a BIG update for ya'll today with a lot of new content, and more content coming soon!
[list]
[*]Stamina is now required for running and jumping
[*]Freeze spell has been completely reworked and is now a charge-up spell that shoots Freezeball projectiles which freezes enemies
[*]Adjusted damage and range of a lot of spells: increased range of Spark by 50%, lowered Fireball damage and range
[*]Mana and stamina now fully restore upon respawn to help players get back into action faster
[*]Added option to toggle show map/inventory
[*]Improved Spell Book UI layout and information
[*]Added new Spell Book dialog
[*]Pet Rock Golem has a protective shield
[*]Spooky have a new Bat Swarm attack that can blind you
[*]Boss fights can now lock the room they occur in
[*]Frozen enemies will no longer have a protective ice shield and can now take damage
[*]Enemies can spawn outside rooms and patrol the level
[*]Enemies can dash to close the distance to the player
[*]Enemies now have lunge attacks, such as Skelly and Imp
[*]Increased movement speed and acceleration for various enemies, including Green Imp, Skelly, and Spooky
[*]Tweaked accuracy and damage for Bow Skelly attacks
[*]Updated enemy spawn behavior, stats, and attack patterns in various levels
[*]Tweaked various sound effects, e.g. heavy breathing when exhausted and heartbeat when seriously hurt
[*]Save slots can now be deleted from the save slot screen by pressing Delete or Backspace
[*]Tweaked level generation and improved procedural generation algorithm
[*]Exit portal lights up on the map when active
[*]Fixed bug where a key/button could be bound to multiple actions by introducing a confirmation popup
[*]Many improvements to models, animations, textures, materials and effects
[*]Fixed various sound and collision bugs, improving the overall gameplay experience
[*]Fixed bug where sound was cutting out in certain situations
[*]Added a couple of Easter Eggs in the Town of Iseholt!
[/list]
As always, thank you for your feedback! Let us know what you think of these updates.

For the best experience please delete any old save files you have.
Save files are located here:
[code]Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Spooky Dungeon\saves\
macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Spooky Dungeon/saves
[/code]
Happy dungeon crawling!
